name: tty-thinking-label
description: The input bar stays up for the whole agent turn and shows an activity label above its top divider, then loses the label when the turn ends. Reuses the status-line-ticks LLM fixture because its tool sleeps via `node -e`, which is what makes the mid-turn window observable without a timing race. That tool is `shell_exec`, so the mid-turn label is the `shelling...` verb rather than the `thinking...` base state — the 4s sleep clears the 150ms anti-flicker delay by a wide margin. Auto tool confirmation on purpose: the approval prompt tears the input bar down, and the label must vanish with it

steps.name: no label at an idle prompt
mid-turn: input bar still drawn, tool verb above it
turn ends: label released, input bar stays
